text.feels_intro: How {name}'s scrapes and bruises from falling feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: a reddened graze across the cheek, flecked with dirt.
{name}'s face: a raw, gravelly scrape along the cheek and brow, weeping and swelling, with a purple bruise rising under it.
{name}'s face: the skin is scraped away in a raw, bleeding patch packed with grit, the cheek swollen and the eye beside it puffed half shut.
body: {name}'s back: dusty and rubbed pink where it hit the ground.
{name}'s back: raw scrapes streak the skin, bruised purple where {he} landed hard.
{name}'s back: wide stretches of skin are scraped off and bleeding, grit ground into them, the ribs beneath bruised black.
arm: {name}'s {part}: the elbow and forearm are reddened and rubbed raw in patches.
{name}'s {part}: the elbow is scraped and weeping, with a dark bruise spreading along the forearm.
{name}'s {part}: the elbow is skinned to the red flesh and caked with grit and blood, the whole arm swollen and bruised black from catching the fall.
leg: {name}'s {part}: the knee is scuffed red and the shin rubbed raw in places.
{name}'s {part}: the knee is scraped and weeping, and the thigh is bruised purple from the landing.
{name}'s {part}: the knee is skinned and bleeding, grit packed into the wound, the whole leg swollen and bruised black.

head: {name}'s cheek stings where it hit the dirt, and {his} head swims a little. {name} is startled and shaken, wiping at {his} face.
{name}'s face burns and throbs where the skin was scraped off, and {his} head aches from the fall. {name} is angry and humiliated, flinching from anything that touches it.
{name}'s face is a raw, burning agony full of grit, and {his} head spins from the fall. {name} is dazed, tearful and frightened, barely able to open the swollen eye.
body: {name}'s back stings where it hit the ground. {name} straightens up stiffly.
{name}'s back burns along the scrapes and aches where {he} landed. {name} moves stiffly and winces when {he} twists.
{name}'s back is a raw, burning agony and every breath jars the bruised ribs. {name} gasps, hunched and barely able to sit up.
arm: {name}'s {part} stings at the elbow. {name} rubs it, shaken.
{name}'s {part} burns at the scraped elbow and aches along the bruise. {name} keeps it close and uses it carefully.
{name}'s {part} is a raw, throbbing agony from elbow to wrist. {name} is in shock, clutching the arm and unable to put weight on it.
leg: {name}'s {part} stings at the knee. {name} walks with a slight hitch.
{name}'s {part} burns at the scraped knee and aches in the thigh. {name} limps and winces at every step.
{name}'s {part} is a raw, throbbing agony and will not take weight. {name} falls or needs support to move.

head: {name}'s face feels normal again, though {he} flinches at the thought of the dirt.
{name}'s face is only a little tender. {name} is wary of hitting the ground again.
{name}'s face is tight and itchy under the scabs. {name} is self-conscious and keeps from touching it.
body: {name}'s back is only a little sore when pressed. {name} is wary of falling again.
{name}'s back is tight and itchy under the scabs. {name} avoids lying on it.
arm: {name}'s {part} has its full movement and strength again.
{name}'s {part} is almost back to normal, sore only when pressed. {name} braces it without thinking when {he} stumbles.
{name}'s {part} is tight and itchy under the scabs and stiff at the elbow. {name} favors the other arm.
leg: {name}'s {part} has its full strength and movement again.
{name}'s {part} is only a little stiff in the cold. {name} is careful on rough ground.
{name}'s {part} is stiff and itchy under the scabs and sore after a little walking. {name} limps and rests it when {he} can.

levels: , the ground rushing up as {he} goes down. The skin scrapes raw with a hot sting and {he} grunts as {he} hits the dirt.
where it is already scraped and sore. The ground grinds in again and {he} gasps, struggling to get {his} feet under {him}.
, landing on skin that is already torn and bruised. The pain is huge and burning, and {he} cries out as {he} hits the ground.
, and it is too much. {he} lands bloody and gasping, {his} vision tunneling as {his} body gives up trying to rise.

summary.end: {target} was tripped to the ground {times}, the last time

level.high: Only faint traces of the scrapes remain on {name}'s {parts}.
level.mid: The scabs on {name}'s {parts} have fallen away, leaving fresh pink skin.
level.low: The scrapes on {name}'s {parts} have scabbed over and the swelling is easing.

{name}'s {part} is a sharp, grinding agony at the wrist. {name} is in shock and holds it perfectly still.
leg: {name}'s {part} aches at the ankle and knee from the jarring landing. {name} walks with a slight limp.
{name}'s {part} throbs at the swollen ankle with every step. {name} limps heavily, wincing.
{name}'s {part} is grinding agony and will not take weight. {name} falls or needs support to move.
